<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/odrl#Aggregation">
  <rdfs:comment>A right that allows combining multiple assets or rights into a single entity.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Aggregation</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ03 asks about its type</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ03: Shall the permissions 'Aggregation' and 'Disaggregation' be of the type Transfer Rights?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/odrl#TransferRights"/>
  <!-- Axiom: SubClassOf TransferRights -->
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/odrl#Disaggregation">
  <rdfs:comment>A right that allows splitting a combined asset or right into separate parts.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Disaggregation</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ03 asks about its type</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ03: Shall the permissions 'Aggregation' and 'Disaggregation' be of the type Transfer Rights?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/odrl#TransferRights"/>
  <!-- Axiom: SubClassOf TransferRights -->
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/odrl#TransferRights">
  <rdfs:comment>A category of rights that can be transferred between parties.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Transfer Rights</rdfs:label>
  <vaem:rationale>[OntoGeneration Agent] created: CQ03 defines it as a superclass of Aggregation and Disaggregation</vaem:rationale>
  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ03: Shall the permissions 'Aggregation' and 'Disaggregation' be of the type Transfer Rights?</dc:source>
  <rdfs:subClassOf rdf:resource="http://www.semanticweb.org/odrl#Right"/>
  <!-- Axiom: SubClassOf Right -->
</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/odrl#Right">
  <rdfs:comment>A legal entitlement or permission granted to a party.</rdfs:comment>
  <rdfs:label>Right</rdfs:label>

</owl:Class>

<owl:Class rdf:about="http://www.semanticweb.org/odrl#ContractParty">

  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ06: Expressing the various roles of contract parties within the Permission/Duty element.

</owl:Class>

</owl:Class>

  <dc:source>(competency_question) CQ08: How to provide a 'NOT' expression?

    (competency_question) New CQ6: What operator is used in the constraints of a prohibition?</dc:source>
